documentSummary.name: Agent402
documentSummary.description: Pay-per-call web tools for autonomous agents: 621 priced endpoints settled in stablecoins (USDC, or USDG on Robinhood Chain) over x402 or MPP, free via proof of work for the pure-CPU tools, and finished reports by card. No account and no API key. The same catalog is callable over MCP at https://agent402.tools/mcp and documented at https://agent402.tools/openapi.json.

skills.name: Find a tool for a task
skills.description: Resolve a plain-language task to a callable endpoint with its price and input schema. Free.

skills.name: Route and execute a paid call
skills.description: Resolve a task, buy the result from the seller over x402, and sell it to the caller with a receipt.

skills.name: Model calls priced per request
skills.description: OpenAI, Anthropic Messages and Responses wires over one endpoint, quoted per request and settled at actual usage.

skills.name: Finished research and diligence reports
skills.description: Company, filing, fund, token and domain reports returned as finished documents with cited sources.

skills.name: The x402 seller index
skills.description: Who sells what across the x402 ecosystem, with settlement evidence and router eligibility per seller.

documentationCompatibility.notes: Agent-card skills do not match wallet-activity-summary@1.0. No B4 milestone upgrade from this document.

documentSummary.name: QuantJourney Research Agent Fabric
documentSummary.description: Machine-payable, evidence-backed financial research for agents. 35 deterministic MCP-backed bounded queries are catalogued. Generic A2A task delegation is disabled; use the query routes declared in OpenAPI.

skills.name: Company Snapshot Lite
skills.description: Return a free, bounded factual ticker snapshot with price, selected metrics, freshness and explicit coverage gaps.

skills.name: Earnings Preview
skills.description: Prepare an evidence-backed earnings preview with consensus, revisions, dispersion, historical surprises, valuation context and explicit review questions.

skills.name: Earnings Recap
skills.description: Reconcile the latest reported earnings with consensus, estimate changes, adjusted-close reactions, SPY-adjusted CAR and explicit thesis-review questions.

skills.name: Congress and Government Signals
skills.description: Combine congressional disclosures and government-contract evidence with disclosure-lag warnings.

skills.name: SEC Company Identity
skills.description: Resolve a ticker or company name to official SEC identity and exchange fields.

skills.name: SEC Latest Filing
skills.description: Return the latest official SEC submission for a ticker and bounded form type.

skills.name: SEC Company Facts Compact
skills.description: Project selected current SEC XBRL facts into a small evidence envelope.

skills.name: GLEIF Entity Lookup
skills.description: Resolve an entity name or exact LEI against the official GLEIF index.

skills.name: Treasury Yield Curve Latest
skills.description: Return one latest bounded U.S. Treasury par-yield curve observation.

skills.name: Overnight Rates Latest
skills.description: Return the latest bounded SOFR, EFFR and related official reference-rate observations.

skills.name: SEC Filing Delta
skills.description: Compare selected SEC XBRL facts between the latest two filings of one form type.

skills.name: Government Demand Packet
skills.description: Combine bounded award rollups and materialized contract signals for one ticker.

skills.name: Security Price History
skills.description: Return bounded normalized daily adjusted-close history for one public-equity ticker, with dates, currency, source and freshness. It is not a live quote.

skills.name: Security Screen
skills.description: Screen U.S. public companies or a named U.S. index using a small allowlist of precomputed financial metrics. ETFs and funds are excluded; arbitrary SQL is never accepted.

skills.name: SEC Insider Filing Activity
skills.description: Return recent official SEC Form 4 filing metadata for one issuer. This version reports filing activity and accessions only; it does not claim parsed purchases, sales or ownership changes.

skills.name: Short Interest State
skills.description: Return bounded official FINRA consolidated short-interest observations and optional Nasdaq Trader Reg SHO threshold-list membership. Semi-monthly short interest is not daily short volume.

skills.name: Security Technical State
skills.description: Return latest precomputed technical indicators from an explicit indicator-family allowlist. Use for structured technical state, not a trading signal or live quote.

skills.name: Market Regime Context
skills.description: Return the latest compact market-risk context computed by QJ Analytics from governed Warehouse inputs. It is descriptive evidence, not a forecast or allocation instruction.

skills.name: Stateless Trade Risk Simulation
skills.description: Estimate before, after and delta portfolio volatility, effective number of bets and fractional risk contribution for one bounded hypothetical long-only trade. No order or portfolio state is created.

skills.name: Portfolio Normalize
skills.description: Resolve up to 25 unique long-only tickers and return normalized weights, identity coverage and concentration without creating a stored portfolio.

skills.name: Portfolio Exposure
skills.description: Return compact sector, country, asset-class and supplied-currency exposure for an inline portfolio.

skills.name: Portfolio Volatility
skills.description: Estimate bounded annualized volatility from authorized aligned daily prices or returns.

skills.name: Portfolio VaR and CVaR
skills.description: Calculate bounded portfolio VaR and CVaR from authorized aligned daily prices or returns.

skills.name: Portfolio Drawdown
skills.description: Calculate bounded portfolio and position drawdowns from authorized aligned daily prices or returns.

skills.name: Portfolio Benchmark Risk
skills.description: Estimate portfolio beta, correlation and regression evidence versus one benchmark.

skills.name: Portfolio Factor Exposure
skills.description: Estimate bounded CAPM, Fama-French 3 or Fama-French 5 factor exposure.

skills.name: Portfolio Liquidity
skills.description: Estimate compact position liquidity using observed price-volume history.

skills.name: Portfolio Events
skills.description: Return bounded upcoming-event exposure and event-risk summaries.

skills.name: Portfolio Signals
skills.description: Return compact precomputed technical, congressional and government-contract signals for the largest supplied positions.

skills.name: Portfolio Scenario
skills.description: Run one named or bounded custom QJ Risk scenario over an inline portfolio.

skills.name: Portfolio Position Risk
skills.description: Return compact per-position volatility, beta, correlation and drawdown evidence.

skills.name: Portfolio Performance
skills.description: Calculate whole-portfolio hypothetical constant-weight performance, Sharpe, Sortino and Calmar. Not account TWR/MWR.

skills.name: Portfolio Correlations
skills.description: Calculate the full Pearson or Spearman matrix of aligned daily asset returns; constant-series correlations are null.

skills.name: Portfolio Optimization
skills.description: Calculate stateless long-only fully-invested weights using min_variance, risk_parity or max_sharpe. Research only, no orders or persistence.

skills.name: Portfolio Simulation
skills.description: Simulate a constant-weight portfolio with calibrated lognormal GBM or IID historical bootstrap. Seeded, bounded, not a forecast.
